name: Sural Neuropathy
definition: Sensory neuropathy of the sural nerve producing pain, paresthesia or numbness along the posterolateral calf and lateral foot.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostic testing and ultrasound are selected for persistent/localizing questions.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent focal entrapment or neuroma requires specialist assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada Vata-neuralgic phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Sensory neuropathy of the sural nerve producing pain, paresthesia or numbness along the posterolateral calf and lateral foot.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
